notes.title: Scary Hospital Horror Game is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

it's finally here!


We're pleased to announce that Scary Hospital Horror Game is now available on Steam! There's a 30% discount during launch week to say thanks to anyone who is lovely enough to pick it up:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343580/Scary_Hospital_Horror_Game

	 A brand new Indie Game Company The Next Generation Gaming, introduces their Second Pc title ' Scary Hospital Horror Game' addictive first-person survival horror game 

	 Scary Hospital Horror is a survival horror and Escape game designed for Pc. The Story based on a Scary haunted hospital. Henry Working for a private newspaper company. This company sends too many reporters to investigate and get information about this haunted hospital but on one comeback from this hospital.
now I decided to get information about his haunted hospital. a few days ago I started the search in this hospital. this hospital is haunted and only Freddy was escaped from this hospital.

	The Powerful Unreal Enigne 4 Create Amazing 3D High End Graphics with Interesting Game Play and Stunning Haunted Horror Atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078303/f482eb50b6b3c3b9cd59f49074576f22af2d8cef.gif[/img]

Key Features
[olist]
[*] Hide
[*] Keep Moving
[*] Solve Puzzles
[*] Survive
[*] Trilling horror Experience
[*] Interesting gameplay
[*] Stunning horror Atmosphere
[*] HD Audio
[*] 6 Different Music
[*] 5 Difficulty Modes
[*] Amazing Graphics
[*] Fearful and Tension atmosphere
[*] 
[/olist]

Release Trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2YeqqE_dxIU

We just wanted to say a massive thank you to everyone We hope you can support us with your purchase so we can keep raising the quality bar so one day, we can produce a game that will forever be remembered.

Thanks all

Thanks for playing!
